question: What do judges check before choosing the Gemma challenge winner?
answer_text: The team should identify the model in its README and show the integration in its code or demonstration. Participants should share resources like Gemma 4 resources, the Gemma Quickstart, and the Gemma API docs. This category allows hackers to build with Gemma, Google's family of lightweight, open models.

passages.text: It’s time to see how much you can build with a lightweight, open model. Gemma 4 packs multimodal intelligence into an open-weights model that you can access through the Gemini API. Gemma 4 can help you: Work with text and images to create an assistant that understands more of what users share Build a focused AI tool for learning, creativity, productivity, or your community Experiment with an open model while using the Gemini API to move quickly from an idea to a working prototype Bring your idea to life… what will you build with Gemma 4 today?
